title: Bank Payout Amount on the Pocketwire Business Profile: Treasury Computation Standard
content:
The bank payout amount of a Pocketwire Business Profile is computed from the balance cleared for a bank payout.

**Balance.** The business balance is the balance recorded on the profile. The bank payout amount is fixed only after every refund booked on the profile carries its refund fee credit entry, on a tier that credits part of the transaction fee back on refunds. The bank payout amount is not fixed until every chargeback debited on the profile carries its chargeback fee entry.

**Holds counted against a bank payout.** The holds counted against a bank payout are the amount of every hold entry on the profile less the amount of every hold release entry on it.

**The month's sales.** The sales dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date, by amount. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

**Keep-back and reserve amounts.**
- The refund exposure keep-back is the refund exposure percentage of the month's sales, rounded to the nearest cent.
- The chargeback-ratio reserve is the chargeback-ratio reserve percentage of the rolling month's sales, rounded to the nearest cent.
- The delivery confirmation keep-back is the delivery confirmation keep-back percentage of the month's sales, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Balance cleared for a bank payout.** The balance cleared for a bank payout is the business balance less the holds counted against a bank payout, the bank return keep-back, the refund exposure keep-back, the invoice sales still clearing, the chargeback-ratio reserve, the bank Pay in 4 keep-back and the delivery confirmation keep-back, all taken from that one balance.

**Bank payout amount.** The bank payout amount is that cleared balance capped at the tier's daily payout limit less the payouts already dated on the handling date, never below zero, and rounded to the nearest cent.

**Plain case.** With none of the keep-backs or reserves taken, the amount is the business balance less the holds counted against a bank payout; what remains, never below zero, is paid out in full to the cent within the tier's daily payout limit less the payouts already dated on the handling date.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs, plain case)

Business balance USD 5200.00; hold entries USD 900.00 and hold release entries USD 200.00, so holds counted USD 700.00; cleared balance USD 4500.00. With a daily payout limit of USD 10000.00 and USD 6000.00 already paid out on the handling date, the room left is USD 4000.00, so the bank payout amount is USD 4000.00. With nothing paid out yet that day it would be USD 4500.00.
